_comment: Static code-entry seeds for bank $05 (text control-code engine) stranded functions reached only through computed dispatch (control-code jump tables read through pointers). All decode 0-invalid and tile to a ret boundary; each sits directly after a ret/jp hl. Flat ROM offset = 0x05*0x4000 + (cpu - 0x4000). Includes per-source text-fetch handler stubs (5-byte farcall $bb:02 + jr) targeted by the DialogueTextFetchers/ShortTextFetchers dw tables ($5c3b/$5cc7). Plus $4c9d code, $78f3 code head ($78f3-$7915, ends at ret; $7916-$791f align pad and the FontGlyphs table at $7920 read by DrawGlyph/$7322 are data), and the 32-entry ControlCodeHandlers_05 table ($548f) targets + its 5 no-op ret stubs ($548a-$548e).
